# Philippe Tremblay - Portfolio Website

> Modern, minimal portfolio website built with Astro.js featuring the Messorem purple theme.
> Static site showcasing software engineering expertise, projects, and professional background.

## Project Overview

A personal portfolio for Philippe Tremblay, Founder of Bounce P2P Payment App and McGill Software Engineering graduate. Built with Astro.js for maximum performance and SEO. Features a beautiful purple theme inspired by Messorem Club Cycliste, dark/light mode toggle, and fully responsive design.

Live site: https://philtremblay.github.io
Framework: Astro 5.15.8
Runtime: Deno 2.9.4 (also manages npm dependencies — no separate package manager)

## Architecture

This is an Astro.js static site using:
- File-based routing in /src/pages/
- Component-based UI in /src/components/
- Layout templates in /src/layouts/
- Global CSS with CSS variables for theming
- Zero JavaScript by default (Astro islands architecture)
- Minimal client-side JS only for theme toggle

### Key Technical Patterns

- **Static Generation**: All pages pre-rendered at build time to /dist/
- **Type Safety**: TypeScript configuration with strict mode
- **Theme System**: CSS variables + data-theme attribute + localStorage persistence
- **SEO**: Meta tags, Open Graph, canonical URLs in BaseLayout
- **Responsive Design**: Mobile-first CSS with breakpoints at 768px

## Key Files

### Configuration
- /deno.json - Deno tasks, npm import map (Astro 5.15.8), nodeModulesDir: auto
- /deno.lock - Committed lockfile pinning the full dependency graph
- /astro.config.mjs - Astro config for GitHub Pages (site, base path)
- /tsconfig.json - TypeScript strict mode configuration

### Layouts & Components
- /src/layouts/BaseLayout.astro - Main layout with SEO, meta tags, Header, Footer
  * Accepts title and description props
  * Includes global.css import
  * Sets up canonical URLs and Open Graph tags
- /src/components/Header.astro - Fixed navigation with theme toggle and mobile menu
  * Theme toggle with localStorage persistence
  * Gradient logo text effect
  * Responsive navigation (hamburger menu on mobile)
- /src/components/Footer.astro - Site footer with social links and navigation
  * Social icons: LinkedIn, GitHub, Instagram
  * Copyright notice with dynamic year

### Pages
- /src/pages/index.astro - Homepage with hero, expertise cards, and featured projects
  * Hero section with gradient text and CTAs
  * 3-column expertise grid (Cloud Architecture, Kubernetes, Cycling)
  * Featured project cards (Bounce P2P Payment App)
  * Extensive component-scoped styling
- /src/pages/projects/index.astro - Projects listing page
  * Project cards with status badges, tags, and descriptions
- /src/pages/blog/index.astro - Blog listing page (structure prepared, not populated)

### Styles
- /src/styles/global.css - Global styles and CSS variables
  * Messorem purple color palette (--purple-50 through --purple-900)
  * Light/dark theme color tokens
  * Spacing scale (--space-1 through --space-32)
  * Typography system (system fonts)
  * Utility classes (container, section, grid, cards, buttons)
  * Dark mode via [data-theme='dark'] attribute

### Static Assets
- /public/robots.txt - Search engine crawler instructions

### CI/CD
- /.github/workflows/deploy.yml - GitHub Actions workflow for automated deployment
  * Triggers on push to master branch (master is the default branch)
  * Uses Deno 2.9.4 (pinned) via denoland/setup-deno@v2, with dependency caching
  * Builds to /dist/ and deploys to GitHub Pages

## Color Palette (Messorem Purple Theme)

Primary accent: --purple-600 (#9333ea)
Light mode backgrounds: white, #fafafa, purple-50
Dark mode backgrounds: #0f172a, #1e293b
Text colors: Slate scale for hierarchy
Borders: Light gray (#e2e8f0)

All colors defined as CSS variables in /src/styles/global.css for easy customization.

## Development Workflow

### Setup
```bash
# Requires Deno 2.9.4+ (https://deno.com/)
# No install step — Deno resolves and caches npm dependencies on first task run
```

### Commands
```bash
deno task dev      # Start dev server at http://localhost:4321
deno task build    # Build static site to /dist/
deno task preview  # Preview production build locally
deno task check    # Type-check the Astro project
```

### Project Structure
```
/
├── .github/workflows/    # GitHub Actions CI/CD
├── public/              # Static assets (robots.txt)
├── src/
│   ├── components/      # Reusable UI components
│   ├── layouts/         # Page layout templates
│   ├── pages/           # File-based routing (index, projects, blog)
│   ├── styles/          # Global CSS with theme variables
│   └── env.d.ts        # TypeScript environment definitions
├── astro.config.mjs    # Astro configuration
├── deno.json           # Deno tasks and npm import map
├── deno.lock           # Committed dependency lockfile
└── tsconfig.json       # TypeScript configuration
```

## Customization Guide

### Personal Information
- Update hero section in /src/pages/index.astro (lines 9-32)
- Modify expertise cards in /src/pages/index.astro (lines 46-88)
- Edit featured projects in /src/pages/index.astro (lines 102-136)
- Update social links in /src/components/Footer.astro (lines 4-20)
- Change default meta description in /src/layouts/BaseLayout.astro (line 13)

### Theme Colors
- Edit CSS variables in /src/styles/global.css (lines 9-18 for purple palette)
- Change accent color by modifying --accent and --accent-hover variables
- Dark mode colors controlled by [data-theme='dark'] selectors

### Navigation
- Edit navigation items in /src/components/Header.astro (lines 2-6)
- Update footer navigation in /src/components/Footer.astro (lines 36-39)

### Adding Blog Posts
- Create markdown files in /src/content/blog/ (structure prepared)
- Update /src/pages/blog/index.astro to list posts
- Consider adding Astro content collections for type-safe blog posts

## Deployment

Automated via GitHub Actions on push to master branch:
1. Workflow builds site with `deno task build`
2. Uploads /dist/ folder as GitHub Pages artifact
3. Deploys to https://philtremblay.github.io

Note: GitHub Pages must be set to "GitHub Actions" as the build source (not "Deploy from a branch") for this workflow to publish.

Manual deployment: Build with `deno task build` and deploy /dist/ folder to any static host (Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Pages, etc.)

## Recent Changes

- 2026-08-03: Upgraded to Deno 2.9.4 and pinned the version in CI; committed deno.lock
- 2025-11-16: Switched from Node.js/pnpm to the Deno runtime (deno.json replaces package.json)
- Complete redesign from vanilla HTML/CSS/JS to Astro.js framework
- Implemented Messorem purple theme with dark/light mode
- Added automated GitHub Pages deployment via GitHub Actions

## Notes for AI Agents

- This is a static site - no backend, API routes, or database
- All content is hardcoded in .astro files (not using CMS or content collections yet)
- Theme toggle uses client-side JavaScript in Header.astro (lines 196-220)
- CSS is scoped by component except for global.css
- Build output is excluded from git (see .gitignore for dist/, node_modules/); deno.lock IS committed
- Site is optimized for perfect Lighthouse scores (minimal CSS, zero JS overhead)
- Personal information (name, LinkedIn, GitHub) is scattered across multiple files
- Blog structure exists but is not populated with actual posts yet
